description: Refuse every backgrounded command, every Monitor call, and every backgrounded Agent dispatch up front inside a process-developer run or one of this plugin's subagents (ticket #101, extended to Agent by #139); abort the pipeline when agent-project-issues MCP is unavailable during context extraction; block the developer subagent from ending its turn with an unresolved backgrounded command (ticket #93); block the process-developer session itself from ending its turn with an unresolved backgrounded command or subagent dispatch, or with work no remote has (ticket #23).
